verdict.rationale: Langfuse is documented as open source and self-hostable on your own infrastructure, the same stack as Langfuse Cloud, with deployment paths for Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure and GCP. That lets users decide exactly where their trace data lives. A community user confirms they chose it so sensitive customer data stays off external servers. Missing for 10: no evidence of region selection (e.g. EU/US) for the managed Langfuse Cloud, and no explicit data-residency or compliance documentation.
